Hero.heading: Roasted by hand,
Hero.lead: A small roastery outside Đà Nẵng. Coffee roasted in daily batches, a roast date on every bag. Western pastries made with French butter.
Hero.cafesToday: Two cafés today · Đà Nẵng, Hội An

TodaysStock.heading: Three things, picked before the shop opened.

Workshops.heading: Taught by the people who bake at five.

Story.heading: It began with my grandmother's pan.
Story.lead: She roasted coffee for the family every morning. My mother baked bread for the neighbours. We opened the roastery in 2017 — one kitchen, one oven, one family outside Đà Nẵng.

CtaBand.heading: A bag roasted this morning, posted to your door.
CtaBand.lead: Pay with ZaloPay, MoMo, or cash on delivery. GHN ships nationwide in 2–3 days.
